questions.questionText: Explain one benefit to train operating companies (TOCs) of leasing the trains.
Using a supply and demand diagram, illustrate the impact on the market for rail travel from a decrease in bus fares.

Using Extract B, calculate to two decimal places, the percentage of total income for the rail industry that came from government subsidies between April 2023 and March 2024. You are advised to show your working.
Analyse two possible reasons why the UK Government subsidises rail travel.
Using Extract C, discuss the power that train drivers have in the labour market.
Using Extract D, assess the impact on consumers of Avanti West Coast having a monopoly on its routes.
Assess whether the investment into a new railway line between Birmingham and Manchester can reduce geographical immobility.
UK train manufacturers have urged the government to buy more trains. Assess the possible benefits to the UK economy if the UK Government buys more trains.
Evaluate the extent to which the removal of the cap on bankers’ bonuses will be beneficial to the UK banking industry.
Evaluate whether the social benefits of building nuclear power stations outweigh the social costs.

It is estimated that the income elasticity of demand (YED) for frozen food is -2.37. Using this data and data in Extract D, calculate to 2 decimal places, the likely change in demand for frozen food in December 2022. You are advised to show your working.
With reference to Extract B, explain the impact of labour shortages on aggregate supply.
With reference to Extract C, explain one reason why high food price inflation might affect the living standards of low or fixed-income groups.
With reference to Extract A, analyse two ways trade unions and professional bodies impact the labour market.
With reference to Extract B, discuss the impact of skill shortages on international competitiveness.
With reference to Extract A, assess the economic impact of the increasing number of strikes on the UK economy.

According to the OECD, in 2022 the UK had the third most expensive childcare costs in the world. With reference to Extract B, assess how government economic policies might help to reduce the cost of childcare in the UK.
With reference to Extract D, assess the impact of falling real pay on the UK economy.
The water industry in England and Wales has been transferred into the private sector. Evaluate the extent to which this has resulted in unintended consequences.
Evaluate the impact on the UK economy of the decision to leave the EU.
Discuss whether the growth of a firm will always lead to diseconomies of scale.
Assess the extent to which the objectives of a firm and a consumer might conflict.
Assess whether an ethical stance by a business will lead to stakeholder conflict.
Evaluate the extent to which globalisation has benefitted national and local economies.
Discuss the effects of an increase in the national living wage on employment.
Assess the extent to which supply-side policies for reducing skills shortages may involve policy conflicts or trade-offs.
Assess the potential trade-off between inflation and unemployment.
Evaluate the benefits of regulation in a market.
Explain one reason why an increase in market share might be an important business objective for TUI.
Using a supply and demand diagram, illustrate the impact on the market for global travel after travel restrictions have been removed for consumers.
Using Extract B calculate, to two decimal places, the operating profit margin for TUI in Q3 2023. You are advised to show your working.

Many airlines are now investing in aircraft that are more fuel efficient and use low‑carbon jet fuel in a bid to reach net‑zero carbon emissions by 2050. Using a supply and demand diagram, analyse the likely impact on the market for air travel of improvements in aircraft technology.
Discuss the likely impact of the wildfires in Rhodes on TUI’s break-even level of output.
Assess the possible benefits of market mapping for TUI.
Using Extract D, assess the possible impact of changes in UK interest rates on holiday firms such as TUI.
Assess the likely impact from the growth of the travel and tourism sector on aggregate demand (AD) in the UK.
Evaluate the effectiveness of indirect taxation on demerit goods to reduce childhood obesity in the UK.
Evaluate the extent to which the use of technology might increase productivity for a firm.
Using the information in Extract D, calculate, to the nearest whole number, the index for UK bread prices in 2023. You are advised to show your working.

Sales data shows that demand for 800 g white sliced bread increased by 0.6% between 2022 and 2023. Using this data and Extract D, calculate, to 2 decimal places, the price elasticity of demand (PED) for 800 g white sliced bread between 2022 and 2023. You are advised to show your working.
With reference to Extract A, explain one impact trade unions could have on wage rates.
Analyse two ways in which high inflation affects individuals.
With reference to Extract C, discuss the likely impact of falling attendance in schools on the UK economy.
In Extract B, Lee Anderson claims that “there is no poverty in Britain”. Assess the extent to which poverty exists in Britain.
With reference to Extract A, assess the impact of high imported energy and commodity prices on the circular flow of income in the UK.
With reference to Extract E, assess the possible impact of income inequality on the UK economy.
Evaluate the methods by which the activities of multinational corporations (MNCs) such as Microsoft, Amazon and Google may be controlled.
Evaluate the view that the main causes of unemployment are technological and structural.
Using Extract A and an appropriate calculation, discuss the implications for Tesla of September’s production figures.
Assess whether investment in the labour force is the best way for a firm to increase productivity.
Assess whether a firm should expand during a recession.
Using a suitable diagram, evaluate the importance of supply‑side policies in promoting economic growth.
Discuss the use of venture capital as a source of finance for a firm such as Moko.
Assess the possible economic impact of specialisation in agriculture for a country such as Kenya.
Assess how the depreciation of the shilling may affect Kenyan firms such as Moko.
Evaluate how membership of the AfCFTA might benefit African countries such as Kenya.
Explain one method the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) could use to research the music streaming industry.
Using a supply and demand diagram, illustrate the impact on the market for traditional music formats following the increase in music streaming.
Using the data from Extract B calculate, to two decimal places, the percentage of revenue spent on research and development (R&D) by Spotify in 2021. You are advised to show your working.
Analyse two possible reasons why Spotify might have increased its spending on R&D.
Discuss the benefits for Spotify of using price discrimination.
Using a supply and demand diagram, assess the likely impact on the market for live music if the UK Government reduced VAT on tickets for live music events.
Assess the implications of a fall in unemployment for firms within the music industry.
Assess the benefits for consumers of the music streaming industry being an oligopoly.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the UK Government providing information to reduce the number of smokers in the UK.
Using an AD/AS diagram, evaluate the impact of improving the skills and quality of the labour force for the UK economy.
Using the data from Extract C calculate, to 2 decimal places, the rate of inflation in March 2022. You are advised to show your working.
With reference to Extract C, explain in which month there was deflation and in which month there was disinflation.

Median nominal annual earnings for full-time employees in the UK increased from £25 806 in 2009 to £31 285 in 2021. In the same period, there was an increase of 52% in demand for takeaway meals. Using this data, calculate, to 2 decimal places, the income elasticity of demand for takeaway meals from 2009 to 2021. You are advised to show your working.
Analyse two ways small firms might survive in the competitive restaurant market.
Discuss the possible benefits to takeaway firms of using dark kitchens.
With reference to Extract A, assess the likely impact of rising inflation on the UK restaurant market.
With reference to Extract A, assess problems arising from the inorganic growth used by UK restaurant chains such as The Restaurant Group and Casual Dining Group.
With reference to Extract B, assess potential stakeholder conflicts associated with the growth of dark kitchens.
Evaluate the impact of just in time (JIT) management of stock on the efficiency and competitiveness of firms.
Evaluate the extent to which there is a trade-off between the policy objective of economic growth and the other objectives outlined in Extracts H and I.
Discuss if wage rates in a modern labour market are always determined by supply and demand.
Assess how barriers to entry affect market structure.
Assess the benefits for a firm of adapting its marketing strategies for global markets.
Evaluate the impact of the digital economy on markets and firms.
Discuss the benefits for a firm of operating in a niche market.
Assess the likely impact of the proposed takeover of OMV Slovenija by MOL on the market for fuel in Slovenia.
Using a suitable diagram, assess the benefits of a subsidy in a market such as the French energy market.
Evaluate government policies that can be used to deal with market failure in an economy caused by emissions.
Using Extract A, calculate to two decimal places the 5‑firm concentration ratio for the UK car manufacturing industry. You are advised to show your working.
Explain one reason why there is less likely to be price competition in the car industry.
Using Extract B, calculate to two decimal places the profit for the year margin for Stellantis in 2020. You are advised to show your working.
Using a suitable diagram, analyse the likely impact on the market for new petrol and diesel cars if the government increases the subsidy on new electric cars.
Of all the vehicles made in the UK, 81% are exported, with over half going to the EU. Discuss the likely impact on UK car exports following a depreciation of the pound against the euro.
Assess the likely benefits for Stellantis of selling a range of different car brands.
Assess the benefits to the UK economy of subsidising the Vauxhall car plant in Ellesmere Port.
Assess the likely impact on the UK economy of the Government banning the sale of new petrol and diesel cars from 2030.
Evaluate the effectiveness of using monetary policy to control inflation in the UK.
Evaluate the case for a reduction in the regulations that protect UK employees.
Using the data from Extract A, calculate to two decimal places the UK GDP per capita for 2017. You are advised to show your working.
Figure 1 shows the average hourly wage for different sectors of the UK economy in 2021. Calculate the median hourly wage for the service sector only. You are advised to show your workings.
Using the data in Extract D, calculate the difference in the percentage change in labour productivity for the UK and Denmark between 2015 and 2018. You are advised to show your working.
Analyse two factors influencing labour productivity in either Denmark or the UK.
Discuss the likely impact of low productivity on economic growth in the UK between 2015 and 2018.
Assess the usefulness of the GINI coefficient as a measure of absolute and relative poverty.
The UK has a legal minimum wage. Denmark has no legal minimum wage. Assess the impact of a minimum wage on income inequality.
With reference to Extract B and using a suitable diagram, assess the likely economic impact of the level of investment in Denmark.
Evaluate the importance of wage costs in influencing the location of manufacturing firms.
Evaluate the impact of low or negative economic growth upon a developing economy such as Brazil.
Discuss the usefulness of GDP as an indicator of growth.
Assess the impact of exchange rate changes on economic growth for a country.
Using a suitable diagram, assess the use of fiscal policy to stimulate economic growth.
Evaluate the extent of the trade-off between economic growth and negative externalities.
Discuss the possible impact of economic growth on employment patterns in a country such as Vietnam.
Assess the benefits of being a member of a trading bloc for a country such as Vietnam.
Assess the impact of Multinational Corporations (MNCs) on the national economy of a country such as Vietnam.
Evaluate the impact on European firms of the growing economic power of emerging economies in South East Asia.
Explain one way creative destruction might have affected the clothing market.
Using Extract B, calculate, to 2 decimal places, Boohoo’s gross profit margin for 2019. You are advised to show your working.

In 2019, Boohoo sold 10,501,813 items. This included low cost clothing and more expensive clothing, coats, shoes and jewellery. Using Extract B, calculate, to two decimal places, the average revenue per item sold in 2019. You are advised to show your working.
Analyse two advantages of division of labour to manufacturers in the clothing industry.
Using a supply and demand diagram, discuss the likely effect on the UK clothing market of a 1p tax on clothing.
Assess the likely implications of using share capital to fund expansion for a firm such as Boohoo.
Assess the extent to which enterprise is the most important factor of production for the success of Boohoo.
Assess the extent to which there is a trade-off between Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and profitability for a firm such as Boohoo.
Using a suitable diagram, evaluate the extent to which tradable pollution permits are the most effective way to reduce environmental damage in the UK.
Evaluate the extent to which WT.Social will be able to successfully enter the UK social media market.
Using the data from Extract C, calculate, to two decimal places, the mean rate of unemployment in Scotland between 2008 and 2018.

In August 2018, the seasonally adjusted claimant count for Scotland was 2.7%. With reference to Extract C, explain one reason why the claimant count may be different to the International Labour Organisation (ILO) measure of unemployment in Scotland.
Explain one external cost caused by mass tourism to the city of Edinburgh.
With reference to Extract B, analyse the impact of the tourism industry on two components of aggregate demand (AD) in Scotland.
Discuss the likely impact of the Transient Visitor Levy (TVL) on tourism in Edinburgh.
With reference to Extract D, assess the likely impact of foreign-owned firms on the circular flow of income in Scotland.
Assess the likely impact of the falling rate of unemployment between 2010–2018 on firms in Scotland.
GDP per capita in Scotland increased from £23 720 in 2008 to £29 800 in 2018. Assess whether this increase in GDP per capita is likely to improve living standards for everyone in Scotland.
Evaluate the impact of FDI on a developed economy such as the UK.
Evaluate the likely conflicts between stakeholder objectives as a result of the growth in this market.
Discuss the link between productivity and competitiveness in the UK economy.
Using a suitable diagram, assess the importance of an increase in productivity to UK economic growth.
Assess the importance of technology in increasing the productivity of the UK economy.
Evaluate the use of demand-side policies to increase growth in the UK economy.
Using a suitable calculation, discuss the extent to which the UK fuel market can be described as an oligopoly.
Assess the role of the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) in promoting competition in the UK economy.
Assess the extent to which the model of perfect competition helps to explain how the UK fuel and retail markets work.
Evaluate arguments for the greater regulation of markets in the UK economy.

In July 2008 the jet fuel price per gallon was $3.89. In January 2018 it was $1.95. Calculate, to two decimal places, the percentage decrease in the price of jet fuel between July 2008 and January 2018. You are advised to show your working.
What is meant by the term ‘break-even’?

A company that refits aircraft for airlines was charging a price of £300 000 to refit an aircraft and demand was six refits per year. When the company reduced its price to £298 000 per aircraft the demand increased to seven aircraft per year. Calculate the marginal revenue gained from the decrease in price for refitting an aircraft.
Calculate, to 2 decimal places, the operating profit margin for DAP for the year ending 31 December 2018. You are advised to show your working.
Using a supply and demand diagram, illustrate the likely impact on BA of further bad publicity for the business.

New and more efficient technology has been introduced to the production process of auto-electrical components. Using a supply and demand diagram, illustrate the likely impact of this new technology on the market for auto-electrical components.
Analyse two ways secondary market research may be used by airlines, such as BA, to help increase sales.
Discuss the disadvantages for a firm such as DAP of a bank requiring collateral before giving a loan.
Discuss the importance to BA of survival as a business objective.
DAP specialises in the manufacture of auto-electrical components that are used in alternators and starter motors. Assess the advantages of specialisation for a firm such as DAP.
Assess the government’s decision to reduce air passenger duty (APD) as part of its vision for UK aviation.
Assess the possible impact of rising fuel prices on an airline business.
The European Commission has fined BA for its involvement in a cartel. Assess the extent to which this may negatively impact BA.
Evaluate the extent to which these externalities are likely to benefit the UK economy.
What is meant by the term ‘income’?
Explain why Mint Tutors may have needed an overdraft in February 2019.
Calculate, to 2 decimal places, the forecast number of tutorials for Mint Tutors in the first four months of 2019. You are advised to show your working.

Mint Tutors is considering increasing the price of tutorials to £27.50 in March, April and May. Discuss the likely impact on the demand curve for Mint Tutors from an increase in the price of tutorials during these three months.
Assess the extent to which non-financial motives are important for Christine when running Mint Tutors.
Evaluate the potential impact of Amazon’s market power on its stakeholders.
Evaluate the extent to which food labelling regulations could be considered a government failure.
Using the information in Extract C, calculate the index for UK butter prices in July 2018. You are advised to show your working.
What is meant by the term ‘aggregate demand’?
Using Extract A, explain one impact on competitors of the proposed merger between Sainsbury’s and ASDA.
Using Extract B, calculate, to 2 decimal places, the rate of unemployment for the UK in December 2018. You are advised to show your working.
With reference to Extract B, explain one likely reason for the change in market share of the discount supermarkets.
Using Extract A, calculate, to 2 decimal places, the change in real earnings for October 2018. You are advised to show your working.
Using Extract C, analyse how an increase in cost-push inflation may affect economic growth.
Discuss the possible benefits of e-commerce for consumers.
With reference to Extract B, discuss the impact of falling real wages on the UK supermarket sector.
Assess the likely impact on retailers of a fall in UK unemployment.
Using the extracts, assess the likely impact on consumers and suppliers of the increased market power of supermarkets.
Assess the impact of food price inflation on UK living standards.
With reference to Extract A, assess the likely problems for Sainsbury’s and Asda of their proposed merger.
With reference to Extract D, evaluate the extent to which being a member of a trade bloc promotes economic growth.
What is meant by the term ‘product life cycle’?

Oatly has decreased the price of its oat drinks by 10%. This led to an 8% increase in sales. Calculate the price elasticity of demand (PED) for Oatly’s oat drinks. You are advised to show your working.
Explain one possible benefit for Oatly of operating in a niche market.
Discuss the implications of an over-utilisation of capacity for Oatly.
Assess the likely benefits for Oatly of using penetration pricing for the launch of its new products in the UK.
Using Extracts E and F, evaluate the extent to which fiscal policy could be used to reduce inequality in the UK.
Evaluate the extent to which there is a trade-off between economic growth and negative externalities for a country such as China.
Discuss the extent to which the UK housing market can be described as a market bubble.
Assess the effectiveness of supply-side policies to ease skills shortages in the labour market.
Using Extract C, assess the extent of the trade-off between unemployment and inflation.
Evaluate the role of the central bank in reducing economic risk and uncertainty.
Walkers buys 350,000 tons of potatoes each year. Discuss the benefits to Walkers of using forward markets to buy potatoes.
In 2017 the potato price index rose by 36%. Using an appropriate diagram, assess the possible impact of this on the potato market in 2018.
Assess the extent to which rising input costs are a problem for food and drink firms.
Evaluate the implications of exchange rate volatility for firms.
Using Extract A, calculate, to 2 decimal places, Nike’s profit for the year margin for 2016. You are advised to show your working.
What is meant by the term ‘fixed costs’?
New Balance operates in a competitive market. Explain one reason why a business such as New Balance differentiates its products.
Using Extract B, calculate the break-even point for The Sanctuary. You are advised to show your working.
Using Extract A, calculate, to 2 decimal places, Anta’s total costs in 2016. You are advised to show your working.
Instead of purchasing the second pod outright, The Sanctuary is considering leasing the pod. Explain one likely benefit of leasing for The Sanctuary.

Pictures of the singer Rihanna wearing New Balance’s white leather training shoes appeared in newspapers. This style of shoe temporarily sold out. However people were still trying to buy them in stores and online, leading to excess demand. Using a supply and demand diagram to show excess demand, analyse how this may affect the future price of these shoes.
Using Extracts A and B, discuss whether the decision to open The Sanctuary for long hours was based on financial reasons.
Discuss the extent to which sales maximisation is the main objective for a business such as New Balance.
Assess the potential benefits for The Sanctuary of purchasing a second pod.
Interest rates in the UK were stable between 2007 and 2017. Assess the possible impact of an increase in interest rates on New Balance’s UK operations.
Assess the importance of economies of scale to the success of firms such as Nike.
New Balance has chosen to manufacture its premium shoes in the US and UK rather than in cheaper locations. Assess the extent to which this may cause stakeholder conflict.
Evaluate the extent to which regulation of the energy market may benefit consumers.
What is meant by the term ‘supply’?
The market for housing is not currently in equilibrium. Using a supply and demand diagram, illustrate the excess supply or demand created by the housing shortage.
Using Extract C, explain the problem of scarcity.

Help to Buy Loans are a type of government intervention. Using the data in Extracts D and E, discuss the merits of this type of government intervention in dealing with market failure in the housing market.
Assess whether a shortage of land is the main reason for rising house prices.
The UK government intervenes in the education sector. Education is considered a merit good. Evaluate the likely impact on the UK economy of government intervention in the education sector.

The functions of the price mechanism to allocate resources are rationing, incentives and signalling. Evaluate which of these functions is likely to have had the biggest impact on the coffee shop market in the UK.
Estimated global sales revenue in the cosmetics industry in 2016 was $445bn. Using the data from Extract C, calculate the total global market share of L’Oréal.
What is meant by the term ‘brand’?
Using Extract D, explain one possible reason why the growth forecast for the niche market in North America is greater than for the mass market.

Estimates indicate that a 2.3% rise in incomes in the UK would result in an 8% increase in demand for premium chocolate. Calculate, to 2 decimal places, the income elasticity of demand (YED) for premium chocolate. You are advised to show your working.
Using Extract A, explain the difference between absolute and relative poverty.
Hotel Chocolat imports all its cocoa from Saint Lucia. Using the trend shown in Extract A for the period 2016–2017, explain one possible impact on chocolate manufacturers, such as Hotel Chocolat.
With reference to Extract B, analyse how underemployment might contribute to the gender pay gap.
Discuss how the economic cycle might affect manufacturers of premium chocolate, such as Hotel Chocolat.
By 2021, total sales of cosmetic products in the Asia Pacific region are forecast to increase by $23.5bn. Discuss the likely effects on a firm such as L’Oréal of this projected rise in sales.
Assess the benefits of organic growth for a firm such as Hotel Chocolat.
Assess the factors that determine the pricing strategy for a cosmetic firm such as L’Oréal when entering an emerging market.
India imposes quotas on imported cosmetics. Using a suitable diagram, assess the likely impact of quotas on Indian cosmetics producers and consumers.
Using Extract E, assess the likely benefits to Natura of purchasing The Body Shop.
Evaluate the extent to which the environmental impact of multinational firms, such as Starbucks, can be controlled by governments.
What is meant by the term ‘exports’?
Using Extract C, calculate, to 2 decimal places, the percentage change in the amount of foreign direct investment (FDI) for Brazil from 2014 to 2017. You are advised to show your working.
Using Extract C, explain one impact these unemployment rates may have on the Brazilian government.
Discuss the possible advantages for Brazil of being a member of a trading bloc.
Assess the benefits of inward foreign direct investment (FDI) flows to a country such as Brazil.
Evaluate the extent to which quality is important for car manufacturers such as Toyota and Tesla.
Evaluate the extent to which a reduction in taxation will increase a country’s rate of economic growth.
Discuss the possible effect of migration on skills shortages.
Assess the connection between productivity and wages.
Assess the impact skills shortages may have on international competitiveness.
Evaluate the policy options the Swedish government might use to reduce unemployment.
Discuss the benefits of division of labour for a manufacturer such as Adidas.
Intel, Samsung, LG and Microsoft have all moved production bases to Vietnam. Assess the possible impact of this on the local labour force in Vietnam.
Assess the importance of having an ethical supply chain for a business such as Adidas or Intel.
Evaluate the importance of the labour force when choosing a location for production.

Candy Kittens’ sales revenue in 2016 was £1.5m. Jamie Laing is planning for an increase in sales revenue of 12% by 2019. Calculate the planned sales revenue for Candy Kittens in 2019. You are advised to show your working.
What is meant by the term ‘entrepreneur’?

According to a new report, confectionery sales in the UK are predicted to grow, despite fears about the high levels of sugar in sweets. (Extract A) Explain one external cost caused by the consumption of sweets.
Calculate, to 2 decimal places, the gross profit margin for SSL in 2015. You are advised to show your working.
Using Extract B, explain one supply factor that may have caused fluctuations in the price of sugar.
Explain the opportunity cost for Elliot and Adam of setting up SSL.

Research suggests that the biggest growth barrier for UK start-up firms is the UK tax system. (Extract C) Using a supply and demand diagram, analyse the likely impact on the UK confectionery market of an increase in indirect taxes.
Discuss the benefits of limited liability to Elliot and Adam when operating SSL.
Discuss the benefit that adding value brings to Candy Kittens.
